lines.en: I am nudged a little.
My feet slide on the floor.
I wobble and hold.
Someone tries to move me away.
I am turned to face elsewhere.
I press a mark into the floor.
I am pushed to the middle of the room.
I am dragged a short way.
My parts knock together.
I am put back by the wall.
I sit crooked and block the door.
My shadow shifts on the floor.
I simply stand here.
I make no sound.
My face points straight ahead.
My joints are locked.
Five hundred points. Take your time.
The light hits me from the side.
My paint has chipped.
I am waiting for someone.
Dust covers me.
I hold this expression.
In the lamplight my shadow is short.

lines.zh: 头顶的吊扇转着，我数它的圈。
lines.en: The ceiling fan turns; I count its circles.
I am heavy and stand solid.
I have stood here a long time.
I face you squarely.
You stop in front of me.
I neither move nor speak.
From what angle do you see me?

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔是画上去的，不会眨。
lines.en: My pupils are painted on; they never blink.
Did you touch me?

lines.zh: 你摸我的漆面，凉得像铁。
lines.en: You touch my paint; it's cold as iron.
Going behind me changes nothing.
My face never changes.
You have stared at me for a long time.
I do not answer you.
My shadow lies over your feet.
You stand very close to me.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，也没有好意
lines.en: I mean neither harm nor kindness.
What do you see in me?

lines.zh: 灯光把我的脸照得分明
lines.en: The light shows my face plainly.
You wait for me to move; I will not.
I hear your breathing plainly.
A crack opens on me.
I am knocked crooked.
A patch of my paint chips off.
I give out a dull sound.
One of my joints is out of line.
I lean slowly to one side.
Something rattles inside me.
A line is scored across my face.
I have not fallen.
I straighten a little.
You hold that up before me.
I have no hands to take it.
Nor would I eat it.
You set it at my feet.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我的眼珠不动。
lines.en: You hold it high; my eyes don't move.

lines.zh: 我张着手，却接不住任何东西。
lines.en: My hands are open, yet they catch nothing.
Hold it long enough and your arm tires.
I need nothing.
I am a prop.
Take it back.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，退了一步
lines.en: You hit me and step back.
I have not shifted a foot.
The knock rocks me a little.
My feet grind on the floor.
Hitting me is like hitting a post.
You squeeze past me.
My centre of gravity is low.
I will not fall over.
We knock out one heavy sound.
I am still standing.
Another is set beside me.
We face the same way.
Two shadows join into one.
It is a little shorter.
Neither of us makes a word.
Our colours differ slightly.
It is moved closer.
We block that wall together.
No one pays either of us mind.
We simply stand.
Something falls at my feet.
I cannot pick it up.
It leans against my leg.
It knocks a sound out of me.
Someone kicks it away.
I pin one corner of it.
It is stuck between me and the wall.
All I can do is watch it.
It is hidden by me.
A little more dust on me.
The light goes out for a moment.
Someone has come in.
I hear the hinge.
My face is square to the door.
I can see that direction.
Footsteps circle me.
I keep watching the door.
Not a bit of my face has changed.
The air here has grown heavy.
Something is approaching me.
I hear cloth rustle.
I see a shadow again.
I stay still and wait.
My face turns toward that sound.
This quiet is wrong.
I do not know what it is.
That shadow is in front of me.
It has not left.
I see it shift a little.

lines.zh: 我这把脸一直冲着那儿
lines.en: My face stays turned that way.
I cannot look away.
It is three steps from me.
I hear it breathing.
My joints feel tight.
What is it waiting for?
Nothing about me has changed.
It has moved to my side.
I see its hand lift.
I still do not move.
The whole room is silent.
Its shadow covers my feet.
Fifty health; I can sit here.
It has no plans to leave.
I keep my eyes open.
It shoves me into you.
My whole body slams forward.
My arm hits your shoulder.
I fall and pin your leg.
I am swung like a weapon.
My foot hits your chest.
This shove drives you back two steps.

lines.zh: 我落地时地板震了一下
lines.en: The floor shakes when I land.
I knock the door open as I fall.
That one cracked me too.
I crash on the desk and break its leg.
My shadow sweeps across your face.
The impact lifts me half an inch.
My parts scatter on the floor.
I pin its foot down.
I settle upright again.
I am put into this room.
Something new stands under the light.

lines.zh: 我的影子先出现在墙上
lines.en: My shadow appears on the wall first.

lines.zh: 我落地时地板响了一声
lines.en: The floor creaks when I land.
I face the door exactly.
My paint is still fresh.

lines.zh: 屋子里的空气冷了下来
lines.en: The air in the room cools.
I am set in the corner.
No one carried me in.
I simply stand here.
My face turns toward the monitors.

lines.zh: 我的位置刚好挡住视野
lines.en: My spot blocks the view.
I am not part of the show.

lines.zh: 我身上一点声音都没有
lines.en: There is no sound from me.
I am stood at the end of the corridor.
No one saw me arrive.
My expression is already set.
I will simply stand and wait.
My surface curls from the heat.
I fall from the platform.
Water seeps into my seams.

lines.zh: 五百点身子砸在墙上，灰直掉。
lines.en: Five hundred pounds hits the wall; dust falls.
Something sticks in my chest.
Spell light leaves a mark on me.
I do not eat; I only age.
Lightning strikes above me.

lines.zh: 脚下的地板没了，我还在。
lines.en: The floor's gone; I'm still here.
